remarks: Highest and Best by Tuesday, April 21st at 11:00 am. Tucked on a quiet cul-de-sac in central Wilton, 43 Twin Oak is the kind of home that makes everyday living feel just a little easier. Thoughtfully updated while preserving its classic charm, this 4-bedroom home shines with recently refinished floors, fresh interior paint, and a newly paved driveway that sets the tone from the start. The beautifully renovated primary bath and updated hall bath bring a touch of spa-like comfort, while the first-floor laundry adds a practical upgrade buyers love. Sunlit living spaces flow effortlessly, creating a warm, inviting feel throughout. The basement currently provides 1,500+ square feet of storage, but it can easily be converted to a gym, playroom, and/or media room. Step outside to sweeping lawns and nearby access to the Norwalk River Valley Trail-perfect for morning walks or weekend adventures. All just minutes to town, train, and Wilton's top-rated schools. Quiet, convenient, and move-in ready...this one is worth the visit.
